findings.problem: PLAN §8 / DESIGN §9 list two more routes that are reachable without a session and that the smoke suite never touches: `/invite/[token]` (the 'Open in app' page, the mobile entry point) and `/auth/callback` (route handler). Under the mock env both must degrade gracefully (the Supabase call fails) instead of 500-ing; nothing asserts that, and the Goal claims 'every public page renders'.
findings.fix: In Build 3 add `/invite/not-a-real-token` to the rendered-page checks (200 or a rendered 'invitation not valid' page — read `app/(auth)/invite/[token]/page.tsx` for the copy — and the 'Open in app' link with the `anacast://` scheme present when the page renders an invitation), and in Build 4.6 add `GET /auth/callback` without `code` → 3xx to `/login` (or the documented error page), never 500. Add both to the `done_when` route list.

findings.quote: If OTP mode exists, toggle it and assert the code field appears only after "Send code".

findings.fix: Replace with: 'Switch to the OTP (email code) mode of `/login` (read `src/features/auth/*` for the control name); assert the 6-digit code field appears only after "Send code", and that submitting the email under the mock env shows the mapped generic error, never a stack trace.'

findings.problem: PLAN §10 'Never cut' names 'users/permissions grid + invite/direct-create'. The full E2E exercises only direct creation; the invitation path (`InviteDialog` → `create_invitation` → copy link → `/invite/[token]` → accept → membership `active`, 3.2b + 2.1a) is never automated, although it is the only zero-key onboarding path Phase 1 ships and the founder relies on it in Part B of the acceptance script.
findings.fix: Add step 5b to `01-acceptance.spec.ts`: as the admin open Invite dialog → email `<tag>+invitee@example.invalid`, one permission (`bulletins.upload`) → with no `RESEND_API_KEY` on the target the dialog shows the link → capture it → new `browser.newContext()` → open the link → complete the sign-up/accept flow built by 2.1a (read `app/(auth)/invite/[token]/page.tsx`) → back as admin `/o/<tag>/invitations` shows it accepted and `/users` lists the invitee with exactly that box ticked; also assert `/invitations` → Revoke on a second pending invitation makes its link show the 'not valid' state. Add `<tag>+invitee` to `cleanupRun`. Extend `done_when` item 2 accordingly.

findings.quote: try a 60 MB file → clear "exceeds the 50 MB plan limit" message
findings.problem: The script tells the founder to use a 60 MB file but not how to obtain one; without it the row is skipped.
findings.fix: Add to the row: 'create one with `head -c 62914560 /dev/urandom > too-big.mp3` (macOS/Linux) or `fsutil file createnew too-big.mp3 62914560` (Windows) — the browser reports it as `audio/mpeg` by extension, so the size check fires first'.
